name: fishops-workbench
description: FishOps Workbench —— Vue 3 工作台 + MV3 扩展运行时（P1：工程骨架与 Bridge）

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @fishops/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @fishops/extension && npm run typecheck --workspace @fishops/workbench
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:extension && npm run build:workbench
scripts.agent:setup: npm run agent:build && npm run agent:configure
scripts.test: npm run test:background && npm run test:platform --workspace @fishops/extension && npm run test:chat && npm run test:capture && npm run test:analysis && npm run test:publish && npm run test --workspace @fishops/workbench && npm run test:agent && npm run test:regression
